    if "Stock" in obj.Name or "Material" in obj.Name:
        has_stock = True
        print(f"Found existing stock/material object: {obj.Name}")
        break

if not has_stock:
    print("No stock object found. Creating one...")
    
    # Get the target shape bounding box to determine stock size
    # The part is a Box with a subtractive Prism (pentagonal pocket)
    # From the check: Box is 48x32x14, and the prism is subtractive
    
    # Create a stock block that fully contains the target shape
    # Add some margin around the part
    stock_x = 60  # slightly larger than 48
    stock_y = 50  # slightly larger than 32
    stock_z = 20  # slightly larger than 14
    
    # Create stock using PartDesign::AdditiveBox
    body = None
    for obj in doc.Objects:
        if obj.TypeId == "PartDesign::Body":
            body = obj
            break
    
    if body:
        body.setEdit()
        
        # Create a new additive box for stock
        from PartDesign import AdditiveBox
        stock_box = body.newObject("PartDesign::AdditiveBlock")
        stock_box.Label = "Stock"
        
        # Set dimensions
        stock_box.Length = stock_x
        stock_box.Width = stock_y
        stock_box.Height = stock_z
        
        doc.recompute()
        body.unsetEdit()
        print(f"Created Stock block: {stock_x}x{stock_y}x{stock_z}")

# Now set up CAM operations
print("\nSetting up CAM operations...")

# Check if Path workbench is available
try:
    import Path
    print("Path module available")
except ImportError:
    print("Path module not available directly")

# Try to activate Path workbench

    print("Activated Path workbench")
except:
    pass

for obj in doc.Objects:

        break

print(f"Target part: {target_part}")

# Create a tool
from PathScripts.PathToolController import ToolController
from PathScripts.PathToolLib import ToolLibrary

# Create a job

try:
    job = Path.Job.Create(doc, target_part)
    job.Label = "Machining Job"
    print(f"Created job: {job.Name}")
except Exception as e:
    print(f"Error creating job: {e}")

# Save the document
doc.saveAs("/home/user/Unnamed.FCStd")
print("Saved document to /home/user/Unnamed.FCStd")

FreeCAD.closeDocument(doc.Name)
print("Done!")
